friendly_name: Mirror three glossary terms into the built-in pack
purpose_context: Operators meet these three terms in spec-kitty upgrade output, the upgrade recovery runbook and two ADRs, but only the in-repo docs/context glossary defines them. Mirroring them into the shipped glossary pack and this project's seed makes the glossary tooling resolve them for every consumer.
purpose_tldr: Ship the tool-surface drift, integrating worktree and target-owned bookkeeping terms to every consumer through the built-in glossary pack.
contracts_rationale: Data-only glossary mirror: no API, CLI or event interface is added or changed.
